acceptanceCriteria: internal/testacceptance freshness reads its admitted runner versions from the shared tuple table; acceptance on 1.64.0/v22.23.2 is admitted; the reporter Node pre-filter derives from the table; tests fail on the old literals.
body: Found by the #1270 lane (V1-2009, PR #1345). PWP-V0-050..052 moved the freshness tuple to the shared Go table and added 1.64.0 on Node v22.23.2, but internal/testacceptance/freshness.go:21 still hardcodes runner 1.63.0, so acceptance on 1.64.0 still refuses. The reporter's external Node pre-filter (v22.23.2, v24.11.1) is a fixed list rather than read from the table. Expected: both derive from the shared tuple table.
title: internal/testacceptance freshness still hardcodes Playwright 1.63.0 and the reporter keeps a fixed Node pre-filter
